description: Founded in 2022, Pelit Park Hotel is ideally located just 5 minutes from the airport and city center, and only 2 minutes from Forum Mall. Minibuses pass right in front of the hotel, providing easy access to the city center. We offer clean and comfortable rooms designed for your relaxation, with free parking and friendly service. Our reception staff speak English and are always ready to assist you, ensuring a smooth and pleasant stay.
about_page_title: A Story of Hospitality and Heart
about_page_intro: Pelit Park Hotel was born from a passion for welcoming guests with warmth and creating a home away from home in the heart of Trabzon.
story_paragraph1: Since opening its doors, Pelit Park Hotel has stood as a boutique destination where modern comfort meets the charm of the Black Sea coast. Designed with thoughtful touches and tailored services, every stay reflects our commitment to hospitality.
story_paragraph2: We are proud to welcome travelers from all over the world and share the vibrancy of Trabzon. Whether you visit for business or leisure, we believe every guest deserves to feel relaxed, connected, and cared for.
founder_description1: Ali Şahin envisioned Pelit Park Hotel as more than a place to stay. Inspired by the warmth of Trabzon’s people, he set out to create a haven where every visitor is welcomed like family.
founder_description2: His attention to detail, love for the city, and dedication to service guide our team every day. With multilingual staff and thoughtfully designed spaces, Ali ensures that each guest enjoys a seamless and memorable experience.
goals_title: Our Goals at Pelit Park Hotel
goal1_desc: From local flavors to cultural experiences, we showcase the heritage of our city so guests can connect with the authentic character of the region.
goal2_desc: Every room and service is designed to feel personal—from spacious suites to 24/7 reception—so you can unwind with ease.
goal3_desc: We believe in genuine hospitality. Our goal is to create long-term connections with guests who return to Pelit Park Hotel year after year.

explore_page_title: Discover Iconic Destinations Near Pelit Park Hotel
explore_page_intro: From historic monasteries to serene lakes and lively bazaars, these must-see spots put you moments away from the best of Trabzon.
explore_page_highlight_note: Start with the legendary Sumela Monastery, then follow the coastline and the mountains to experience Trabzon like a local.
explore_place1_desc: A cliffside Orthodox monastery hidden in Altındere National Park, offering dramatic views and centuries of history.
explore_place2_desc: A postcard-perfect lake surrounded by lush hills, ideal for nature walks, fresh air, and scenic cafés.
explore_place3_desc: A restored Byzantine-era church-mosque with striking frescoes and sweeping Black Sea views from the gardens.
explore_place4_desc: A hillside lookout where you can sip Turkish tea while watching the city and shoreline from above.
explore_place5_desc: An elegant villa showcasing early 20th-century architecture, lush gardens, and memorabilia from Atatürk’s visits.
explore_place6_desc: A calm reservoir west of the city, perfect for paddleboats, lakeside meals, and golden-hour photos.
explore_place7_desc: One of the world’s longest caves with underground streams, cool air, and wooden walkways for easy exploring.
explore_place8_desc: A lively seaside promenade with cafés, walking paths, and calm sea views — a popular spot in Trabzon for relaxing moments.
explore_place9_desc: Ancient fortifications that line the old town, offering a walking route through layers of Roman and Ottoman history.
explore_place10_desc: A green valley park with ponds, bridges, and cafés—perfect for an evening stroll close to the city center.

travel_tips_page_title: Make the Most of Your Trabzon Stay
travel_tips_page_intro: Arriving in Trabzon is effortless with Pelit Park Hotel as your base. Use these practical tips to plan, explore, and unwind like a local.
tips_section_intro: Simple reminders to make your trip smooth—from airport pickups to planning day trips along the Black Sea.
tip1_desc: Pelit Park Hotel is just 5 minutes from Trabzon Airport. Book a taxi in advance or ask our front desk to arrange a pickup when you land.
tip2_desc: Coastal breezes and mountain air can shift quickly. Bring light layers and a rain jacket so you stay comfortable on every outing.
tip3_desc: Minibuses pass directly in front of the hotel toward the city center. For longer trips, we can help you book private cars or guided tours.
tip4_desc: Grab a local SIM card at the airport or rely on our fast Wi‑Fi throughout the hotel—perfect for maps, messaging, and bookings.
tip5_desc: Modest dress is appreciated at mosques and cultural sites. A simple scarf or light jacket is useful when visiting historic landmarks.
tip6_desc: Start early for Sumela Monastery or Uzungöl to avoid traffic. Evenings are ideal for tea at Boztepe Hill or a stroll along Ganita Coast.
guides_section_intro: Our team loves sharing Trabzon. Use these quick notes to plan with confidence and experience the city like a local.
guides_list1: Ask reception to schedule taxis, day tours, or airport pickups—available 24/7 with multilingual support.
guides_list2: Keep a mix of cash and cards. Most cafés accept cards, but smaller markets and dolmuş rides prefer cash.
guides_list3: Prayer times influence opening hours at some sites. Check schedules for mosques and museums before heading out.
guides_list4: Try Trabzon specialties like kuymak and pide near the bazaar, then head to the coast for sunset views.
tips_cta_desc: Our concierge can map your day, reserve restaurants, and share the latest events across Trabzon.

flexible_section_body: Travel plans change. Our booking team makes it easy to adjust dates, extend your stay, or find the right room for your needs so you can focus on enjoying your time in Trabzon.
